context: M27 o4. (Nick.) The loading dock. Brannock smoking. Nick holds out an envelope.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Detective. You keep a little something in your spare tyre, I hear.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Nobody. I'm in a generous mood. The lieutenant's locker key. Penn Station. Yes?

lines.speaker: char.jimmy_brannock
lines.text: …Four-eighteen. He checks it Fridays. Today's Thursday. Make it fast.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I don't break laws, detective. I read them carefully. A lawyer taught me.
